configuration.name: My Articles Expiring This Month
configuration.offlinesqlquery: /*SelectStart*/select  "knowledgearticle0".[articlepublicnumber] as "articlepublicnumber" , "knowledgearticle0".[knowledgearticleid] as "knowledgearticleid" , "knowledgearticle0".[title] as "title" , "knowledgearticle0".[expirationdate] as "expirationdate" , "knowledgearticle0".[majorversionnumber] as "majorversionnumber" , "knowledgearticle0".[minorversionnumber] as "minorversionnumber" , "knowledgearticle0".[statecode] as "statecode" , "knowledgearticle0".[statuscode] as "statuscode" , "knowledgearticle0".[languagelocaleid!id] as "languagelocaleid!id" , "knowledgearticle0".[languagelocaleid!logicalname] as "languagelocaleid!logicalname" , "knowledgearticle0".[languagelocaleid!name] as "languagelocaleid!name"/*SelectEnd*/  /*FromStart*/from  KnowledgeArticle as "knowledgearticle0"/*FromEnd*/  /*WhereStart*/where  ("knowledgearticle0".[statecode] = 3 and  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', "knowledgearticle0".[expirationdate]) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', DATETIME('now')) and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', "knowledgearticle0".[expirationdate]) < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', DATETIME('!start-of-today-utc!', '+31 day'))  and "knowledgearticle0".[isrootarticle] = 0 and ("knowledgearticle0".[ownerid!id] = "!eq-userid!" or "knowledgearticle0".[primaryauthorid!id] = "!eq-userid!"))/*WhereEnd*/  /*OrderByStart*/order by  "knowledgearticle0".[expirationdate] desc/*OrderByEnd*/
